title: 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Rate
revision_note: FRED's H.15 constant-maturity series is not revised after publication.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)

methodology: Daily par yield on a 10-year U.S. Treasury note, interpolated by the Treasury from the daily par yield curve and published by the Federal Reserve as the H.15 constant-maturity series, series ID DGS10.
notes: Values are percent (4.25 means 4.25%), not a decimal fraction.
No observation is published on weekends or U.S. bond-market holidays; those dates are simply absent, not zero.

presentation.summary: Daily 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield, from FRED.
